title: US Strategy: After The Inflationary Boom

US Strategy: After The Inflationary Boom

Will Denyer, Tan Kai Xian

Gavekal Research | 30 Sep 2026

For now, the US remains in an inflationary boom driven by AI investment and rising energy prices. Such an environment favors tech and energy stocks, and cash over bonds. While this backdrop could persist, the risks are rising that further energy disruption triggers a full-on inflationary bust or that higher interest rates and energy prices eventually tip the US economy into a deflationary bust. This, argue Will and Kai Xian, calls for a more balanced portfolio, with investors adding inflation hedges such as TIPS and energy stocks alongside high-grade nominal bonds to protect against a change in the macro regime.
